name: 'S
source:
After the disaster people hide in underground colonies, and now return to recolonize the Earth. Treasure hunters exploring territories become top needed profession. A training school for treasure hunters is established. Young adults get practice skills there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
灾难发生后，人们躲进地下殖民地，如今又回到地表重新开拓地球。探索未知地区的寻宝猎人成为最受需要的职业，于是寻宝猎人培训学校成立了，年轻人在那里学习和磨炼技能。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
